name: Spirit Sisters
source:
The Egyptian Gods have returned.

In a world reborn under the influence of ancient deities, the Egyptian Orthodox Church emerges, a devout order striving to honor and sustain this divine resurgence. 
Wendy, a blue-haired Demigoddess is selected to act as the Vanguard for the Church.
Alongside her stands a silver-haired sister of faith, named Hibiki.

Together, this unlikely duo faces a sinister cult bent on summoning 7 sinister demons. As battles rage and shadows close in, a bond deeper than faith begins to grow—a love forged in the crucible of danger and destined to challenge the fabric of their beliefs.

Will Wendy and Hibiki’s resolve be enough to stem the tide of darkness? And can their newfound connection withstand the weight of their divine mission?
This is their story, Spirit Sisters!

[From [url=https://tategami-kun.itch.io/spirit-sisters]Itch.io[/url]]
